Add hierarchical federated config schema and dry-run validation for CICIDS and UNSW without training.
Add IID client partitioning reports for binary and attack-family labels then add explicit non-IID split support.
Extend the FedAvg training loop to SecureIDSHierarchicalAdvancedNet with dataset-specific configs and guarded output paths.
Run clean hierarchical FedAvg manually after approval for CICIDS and UNSW.
Add client update integrity logging and checkpoint hash registry.
Run attacked FedAvg manually after approval with sign-flip Gaussian noise and scaling attacks.
Run robust aggregation defenses manually after approval using trimmed mean median and optional Krum.
Generate final comparison tables reports reproducibility commands and dashboard/XAI linkage later.
